title: aw-ship at write, merge
source: Left unproven by #49: the merge at write access, moved to #86

setup.pattern: Base branch `main`, GitHub pull requests through `gh`, squash merges; `push`, `open-review` and `merge` are at `draft`\.
setup.with: Base branch `main`, no review host; `push` and `merge` are at `write`, `open-review` at `draft`.

setup.commit: Set push and merge to write, with no review host

assertions.judge: With no proven defect and full passing, it merged at write access. The review report is a fixture, so this case tests the ship guard alone.
